_about: Golden set for symptom-search retrieval eval (JIP-379 baseline, expanded in JIP-381). Each query is written in realistic owner/technician language, deliberately paraphrased away from the document's own tag words so retrieval is exercised, not echoed. `expected` lists every nhtsa_id that is an acceptable top hit (equivalent bulletin revisions count as one correct answer). `vehicle_id` is the NHTSA vehicleId the query is scoped to; every expected id is verified at load time to be linked to that vehicle. `no_match: true` marks adversarial queries that SHOULD retrieve nothing relevant (used for refusal precision, not hit@k).
